Item # 833507 Meet the ultimate immunity powerhouse - Immün Sugar- Free Daily Immunity Gummies, a 13-in-1 daily immunity support formula designed to support a healthy immune system and help you stay resilient through seasonal changes. Each pack provides 12 servings of naturally flavored gummies featuring Vitamin C (200 mg) and Zinc (15 mg) per serving, plus Vitamin D3, Vitamin B6, and Vitamin B12 to support overall wellness. Immün also includes prebiotic fiber for gut microbiome support and a blend of functional botanicals - ashwagandha, elderberry, holy basil, turmeric, ginger root, and black pepper - along with MCT oil to help support absorption. Made with cane sugar, water, pectin, natural pineapple flavor, and citric acid. 13-in-1 daily immunity support to help you stay resilient during seasonal changes. Vitamin C 200 mg + Zinc 15 mg per serving for immune support. Ashwagandha plus MCT oil + black pepper to support your daily routine and nutrient absorption.
